technical_analysis.issue: User saw stale/old behavior in iOS test app package despite code fixes
technical_analysis.root_cause: Xcode was not automatically rebuilding web assets before bundling the iOS app
technical_analysis.fix_applied: Added PBXShellScriptBuildPhase 'Sync Web Assets' that runs yarn build + npx cap copy ios during every Xcode build
technical_analysis.fix_correctness: This is the standard Capacitor pattern for ensuring fresh web assets in iOS builds. The build phase runs after Sources/Frameworks but before Resources, ensuring the public/ folder contains fresh assets before being bundled.
technical_analysis.remaining_blockers: None identified from repo-side. User should: 1) Clean Xcode build folder (Cmd+Shift+K), 2) Delete app from device, 3) Rebuild and reinstall
